description: Performance baselines for ray marching optimization (spec 005)

ImplicitGyroid.3mf.notes: Complex TPMS gyroid structure - primary benchmark

wristband_003.3mf.notes: Organic curved surface - tests adaptive omega on varied curvature

SphereInACage.3mf.notes: Mixed complexity - tests distance init buffer effectiveness

RadialRadiator.3mf.notes: Complex lattice structure - stress test (2.7M triangles)

SC-002.algorithm: Enhanced Sphere Tracing (Keinert et al. 2014) with backtracking
SC-002.notes: Replaced gradient-based approach with Enhanced Sphere Tracing. Overshoot detection with backtracking provides reliable ~19% step reduction regardless of SDF gradient characteristics.

v1.0.0.result: ~2% step reduction - ineffective for well-formed SDFs with gradient ≈ 1.0

v1.1.0.approach: Enhanced Sphere Tracing with overshoot detection and backtracking
v1.1.0.result: ~19% step reduction - works regardless of SDF gradient characteristics
